programmes.show_description: Luke's derriere disaster proves to be a two-man job for Sketch and Jay, Alice covers a design that reminds Katie of her ex, and Glen puts a snowman on ice.
Taskmaster Greg Davies delivers rough justice as Ardal O'Hanlon sings about a fence, Judi Love designs classy headgear, and Sophie Duker displays world-class endurance.
Sean Lock, Bob Mortimer, Harry Hill, Joe Lycett, Jon Richardson, Lucy Beaumont, Katherine Ryan and more take on the words and numbers in this best-bits compilation episode.
Teleshopping
Teleshopping
Cindy Galardi Culpepper, the CEO and chairperson of Wienerschnitzel, the world's largest hot dog chain, goes incognito among her staff to look at the company's communication.
Lowell Hawthorne, the president and CEO of Caribbean food producer Golden Krust, goes undercover among the workforce in his own company, to determine the state of the business.
...Selling: Sheryl and Frank's renovations may be the least of the brothers' problems. Instead, earning Frank's trust proves to be as tough as nails.
Three couples compete to host the best dinner party in and around Newcastle. There's Scottish fare and assumptions about accents, and a dessert nearly goes up in flames!
In Manchester, Raf and Kevin serve up a 'healthy' menu featuring chocolate cake, Chantel and Stephen host a backyard party with hot tub fun, and Matthew and Jane dish up Asian cuisine.
The One with the Bear Grylls Groom: Survival expert Tom's only thinking of one thing for his wedding to fiancée Sue: a rugged, outdoor affair amidst the elements on a Scottish island.
The One in a Shopping Centre: Kelly's dream was to be a pro dancer, but her aspirations were cut short by illness. Fiancé David is planning a vibrant wedding with a dancing flash mob.
Country music artist Darius Rucker goes undercover at an open mic night, as a roadie and a busker, in a bid to find fresh songwriting and performing talent.
Restaurateur Marcus Samuelsson dons a disguise to work incognito in a teaching kitchen, a food truck and a culinary institute, searching for undiscovered chefs to mentor.
Mama Rita's: Gordon tries to bring new ideas to Mama Rita's Mexican restaurant in Newbury Park, southern California.
Le Bistro: Gordon visits high-end Le Bistro in Florida. Owner Andy has cooked for top chefs in the past, but he's lost his passion - and he doesn't respond well to criticism.
...and Selling: Brand new series: David and Siobhan keep getting outbid in their city's intense market. What tricks do Jonathan and Drew have up their sleeves to secure a sale?
Bit of an Ick: Anthony spirals into a place he may not be able to come back from. Dylan faces the music. And are Barbie and Kyle more than just friends?
The race for glory heats up as we reach the business end of the series. Bridget Christie researches Welsh royalty, and Judi Love pokes a shoe under a shower curtain.
Jimmy Carr hosts as Jonathan Ross and Russell Kane take on Alan Carr and Judi Love. Josh Jones joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner. With Rachel Riley.
Jimmy Carr hosts as Alan Carr and Harriet Kemsley play against Jonathan Ross and Maisie Adam. Huge Davies joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner. With Rachel Riley.
Seasonal Beatings: It's Christmas Day and Mark has invited his parents over for lunch. He's planned everything, but Jeremy is over-excited, and Dobby and Super Hans show up.
Jeremy Therapised: Mark has asked Dobby to move in with him, but Jeremy is dragging his heels over moving out.
Glen rids Riley of her Valentine's issues, Jay fixes Leon's bedroom problems, Alice covers Suzanne's cocky Cupid, and Sketch divorces Jordan from his tattoo.
The race for glory heats up as we reach the business end of the series. Bridget Christie researches Welsh royalty, and Judi Love pokes a shoe under a shower curtain.
Jimmy Carr hosts as Jonathan Ross and Russell Kane take on Alan Carr and Judi Love. Josh Jones joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner. With Rachel Riley.

Will it be child's play for Sharon John, CEO of Build-A-Bear Workshop, as she works undercover alongside the employees who custom-make stuffed toy animals in her retail outlets?
Karen Freeman-Wilson, the mayor of Gary in Indiana, goes incognito among the city's workforce and meets a sanitation plant operator, a firefighter and a police officer.
...Selling: After buying their home at a top market price, Michelle and Danielle want to ensure they're not losing any money. Will a huge renovation secure a high-selling sum?
In Manchester, Gillian and Steve strive for perfect presentation, Holly and Richard serve a vegetarian menu, and expectations are high for self-confessed foodies Jen and Alex.
In Coventry, joker Neal and Hazel plan a 'restaurant-quality' menu. A shock discovery on Jess and Ed's night has the group in hysterics. And Emma and Huseyin serve up Turkish delights.
The One at a Car Show: Adam has decided to throw his wedding to Victoria in the middle of a car show. With, for some reason, an Elvis impersonator called Elvin officiating the ceremony.
The Demolition Derby One: Kate wants a serious, traditional wedding. But we all know that's not how it works on DTTB. Her fiancé, Kyle, has plans to enter her in a demolition derby instead!
YouTube star and internet sensation Bethany Mota adopts a disguise to go undercover and meet up-and-coming social media hopefuls who are trying to break through.
American football star Deion Sanders goes undercover, disguised as a businessman who hopes to start a youth football programme, to meet inspiring sports coaches and worthy fans.
Gordon Returns 1: Gordon revisits three restaurants - Handlebar, Casa Roma and The Black Pearl - to check in with the owners he helped. Has his advice been put to good use?
Gordon Returns 2: Gordon Ramsay revisits two restaurants - Giuseppi's and Sante La Brea - to find out whether his advice has been put to good use.
...and Selling: Brand new series: Melanie and Derek's home has a pool but it's giving them a sinking feeling. The twins dive headfirst into helping, but will it go swimmingly?
Happy Captain, Happy Life: A new crew member is thrown in at the deep end. Barbie and Kyle struggle after taking their relationship to the next level.
It's the grand final! Why is Chris Ramsey rapping about aubergines? Can Bridget Christie whistle? And will Judi Love ever win an episode?
Jimmy Carr hosts with Rachel Riley and Susie Dent. Jon Richardson and Lucy Beaumont take on Richard Ayoade and Joe Wilkinson. Finlay Christie is in Dictionary Corner.
Roisin Conaty and Joe Wilkinson take on Jon Richardson and Nabil Abdulrashid. David O'Doherty is in Dictionary Corner. With Jimmy Carr, Susie Dent and Rachel Riley.
Business Secrets of the Pharaohs: Mark gets a lucky break when his book is accepted by a 'publisher'. Jeremy enrols on a life coaching course.
The Love Bunker: Simon, Dobby's ex-boyfriend, invites Mark, Dobby, Jeremy and Super Hans to join him and his friends for a paintballing weekend.
